findingDetails.title: The Chrome DevTools install guide registers an unpinned chrome-devtools-mcp@latest fetch
The registered Chrome manuals fetch a package on every call without the operator gate the Bladebro rule requires

results.summary: the phase's no-unpinned-fetch claim contradicts the install guide; the Bladebro gate and installer hardening hold.

noveltyJustification: Two new findings in a new dimension, weighted new 6 against a weighted total of 12 for the run, so half the accumulated signal is new.

reviewDepthApplicability.reason: browser hub scripts, MCP registration and three mode packets cross a package-install trust boundary

targetSelection.selectionReason: every packet surface that fetches, launches or documents a package fetch

searchLedger.hypothesis: the packet teaches an unpinned package fetch
searchLedger.invariant: no browser doc fetches a package without an exact version
searchLedger.rationale: the guide's registration blocks pass an unpinned tag

searchLedger.hypothesis: a browser manual installs code at call time with no operator decision
searchLedger.invariant: an npx launch counts as an install and needs an operator yes

searchActions.result: three chrome_devtools manuals launch npx with a pinned version and no gate

searchLedger.rationale: same act gated for Bladebro and ungated for Chrome

searchLedger.hypothesis: the Aside installer runs unpinned code without an operator decision
searchLedger.invariant: installation is always an explicit operator decision

searchActions.result: operator-invoked wrapper, never called implicitly, docs say so

searchLedger.rationale: documented operator-invoked vendor path with no contrary packet claim
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: the wrapper is never invoked by a workflow and the docs state the gate

searchLedger.hypothesis: a browser example executes page-controlled input
searchLedger.invariant: page content is data, never code

searchActions.result: only the eval envelope is parsed; the URL is scheme-validated and the CDP query is loopback and time-bounded

searchLedger.rationale: no page content reaches the shell
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: the example parses its own JSON envelope, never page text
